title: 第17章 拜别冥河意外之喜第18章 安置幽冥阴阳法则
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
自那晶莹瑰丽的血海底层遁出，帝江的身形再次出现在冥河面前。
冥河一直在此修炼，见帝江归来，且气息平稳，并无异样，心中也是松了口气，同时更加好奇帝江在下面究竟找到了什么机缘，不过他很有分寸地没有多问。
“冥河道友，血海之下机缘已了，本座这便告辞了。
我不周山大门，随时为道友敞开，道友可凭此印信通行不周山大阵。”
帝江对着冥河微微颔首，履行承诺道！
说着，屈指一弹，一道蕴含着他一丝血脉法则气息的银色符印飞向冥河。
这符印既是五行大阵的通行证，也代表了帝江的承诺。
冥河接过符印，感受到其中精纯玄奥的五行之力，心中欢喜，连忙拱手：“多谢道友！
他日定当登门拜访！”
帝江点了点头，目光扫过下方翻涌的血海，心念一动，又顺手摄取了一大团精纯的血海煞气，压缩成一枚暗红色的珠子收了起来。
这煞气对他熟练都天神煞大阵还有用处。
做完这一切，帝江不再停留，对着冥河最后说了一句后会有期，便一步踏出，身形融入空间波纹之中，瞬间消失不见，踏上了返回不周山的归途。
目送帝江离去，冥河摩挲着手中的法则符印，又看了看帝江消失的方向，随后向血海走去！
“紫霄宫听道者众多，待他们听道归来，修为必然大进。
我既选择了不走寻常路，便更不能有丝毫懈怠！
否则，如何践行我‘不弱于人’之道？”
冥河压下心中因错过紫霄宫讲道而产生的一丝微小波澜，身形化作血光，沉入血海深处，决定立刻开始闭关，提升实力。
与此同时，三十三天外，混沌之气缭绕的紫霄宫中。
高坐云床的鸿钧道祖，面容古朴，眼神淡漠，其中蕴含着无尽天道玄机。
目光平静地扫过下方三千蒲团上正襟危坐的洪荒大能。

前排六个紫色蒲团尤为醒目，上面坐着太清、玉清、上清、女娲、接引、准提。
其后则是帝俊、太一、镇元子、红云等一众知名大能，皆屏息凝神，等待着圣人开讲大道。
然而，鸿钧那仿佛能洞彻因果的目光，在扫过某个区域时，微不可察地停顿了一瞬。
“盘古精血所化的帝江，以及血海孕育的冥河。
竟都未至？”
这两个身负盘古因果、根脚非凡的存在，居然双双缺席他这洪荒首次圣人大道宣讲，这确实有些出乎鸿钧的预料。
尤其是那帝江，是他了结盘古因果的人选之一，不过好在三清已至，帝江来不来都无所谓了！
这点意外也仅仅是在鸿钧心中泛起一丝微澜，随即消散。
“大道五十，天衍四九，人遁其一。
各有缘法，强求不得。”
鸿钧心中淡然，既不来，便是无缘，或自有其道！
他并未将此事放在心上。
身为洪荒第一圣，玄门道祖，他的目光早已超脱个体，着眼于整个洪荒天道的运转与完善。
收回思绪，鸿钧不再关注那未至的两人，淡漠高远的声音如同大道纶音，开始在紫霄宫内回荡，阐述那无上玄妙之道！

content_en:
After escaping from the bottom of the crystal clear sea of ​​blood, Di Jiang's figure appeared in front of Styx again.
Ming He has been practicing here. When he saw Di Jiang return, his breath was stable and nothing unusual, he was relieved. At the same time, he was even more curious about what opportunity Di Jiang had found down there, but he was very measured and did not ask any more questions.
"Fellow Daoist Styx, under the sea of blood, the opportunity has passed. I will take my leave now.
The gate of my Buzhou Mountain is open to Taoist friends at any time. Taoist friends can use this seal to pass through the Buzhou Mountain Formation. "
Di Jiang nodded slightly towards the Styx and fulfilled his promise!
With that said, with a flick of his finger, a silver talisman containing a trace of his blood law flew towards the Styx.
This talisman is not only a pass for the Five Elements Formation, but also represents Di Jiang's promise.
Minghe took the talisman and felt the pure and mysterious power of the five elements in it. He felt happy in his heart and quickly handed over his hand: "Thank you, fellow Taoist!
I will definitely visit you someday! "
Di Jiang nodded and glanced at the surging sea of blood below. With a thought, he took in a large ball of pure blood sea evil energy, compressed it into a dark red bead and put it away.
This evil spirit is still useful for him to master the Heavenly God Evil Formation.
After doing all this, Di Jiang no longer stayed. He said one final word to the Styx River: "We will see you later." Then he stepped out, his body blended into the ripples of space, and disappeared in an instant, embarking on his way back to Buzhou Mountain.
Watching Di Jiang leave, Ming He rubbed the law sigil in his hand, looked at the direction in which Di Jiang disappeared, and then walked towards the sea of ​​blood!
"There are many people listening to the Tao in Zixiao Palace. When they return from listening to the Tao, their cultivation will definitely improve greatly.
Since I have chosen not to take the ordinary path, I cannot slack off at all!
Otherwise, how can I practice my way of ‘not being weaker than others’? "
Styx suppressed the slight waves in his heart caused by missing the lecture at Zixiao Palace. His body turned into blood and sank into the depths of the sea of blood. He decided to immediately start seclusion to improve his strength.
At the same time, thirty-three days away, in the Zixiao Palace, the energy of chaos was lingering.
Sitting high on the cloud bed, Taoist Hongjun has a simple face and indifferent eyes, which contain endless mysteries of heaven.
His eyes calmly glanced at the great power sitting on the three thousand futons below.
The six purple futons in the front row are particularly eye-catching, with Taiqing, Yuqing, Shangqing, Nuwa, Jieyin and Zhunti sitting on them.
Afterwards, there were many well-known great masters such as Di Jun, Tai Yi, Zhen Yuanzi, Hong Yun, etc., all holding their breath and waiting for the saint to start teaching the Tao.
However, Hongjun's gaze, which seemed to be able to see through cause and effect, paused for an imperceptible moment when scanning a certain area.
“The Emperor River transformed by Pangu’s essence and blood, and the Styx River bred by the sea of blood.
Haven't even arrived yet? "
These two beings who were responsible for the cause and effect of the ancient times and had extraordinary foundations were both absent from his first sermon on the saint's road. This was indeed beyond Hongjun's expectation.
In particular, Di Jiang was one of his candidates to end Pangu's cause and effect. But fortunately, the Three Purities had arrived, and it didn't matter whether Di Jiang came or not!
This surprise only caused a slight ripple in Hongjun's heart, and then dissipated.
"The Great Dao is fifty, Tianyan is forty-nine, and one of the human escapes is one.
Everyone has his own destiny, and you can't force it. "
Hongjun was indifferent in his heart. If he didn't come, he just didn't have a chance, or he had his own way!
He didn't take it to heart.
As the first sage of the ancient world and the Taoist ancestor of Xuanmen, his gaze has long transcended the individual, focusing on the operation and perfection of the entire ancient heavenly way.
Withdrawing his thoughts, Hongjun no longer paid attention to the two people who had not yet arrived. His indifferent and distant voice, like the sound of the great road, began to echo in the Zixiao Palace, explaining the supreme and mysterious way!
